jobs.title: Senior Logic Design Engineer
jobs.description: Requires 5+ years of experience. B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Electrical or Computer Engineering 5+ years as a VLSI front-end engineer (logic/ASIC/chip design) or in a similar domain Strong background in RTL design, handoff methodologies, and signoff tools (Lint, CDC, RDC)

jobs.title: Circuit Design Engineer
jobs.description: Requires 2+ years of experience. Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering 2-5 years of relevant experience in circuit design Strong understanding of circuit theory and design architectures

jobs.title: Senior VLSI Verification Engineer
jobs.description: Requires 5+ years of experience. 5+ years of experience as a VLSI Verification Engineer Expertise in System-Verilog and UVM Strong software development skills to build reusable verification components and utilities

jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer
jobs.description: Requires 3+ years of experience. 3+ years in IC/system product, test, or yield engineering, including deep post-silicon analytics experience Strong track record in data analysis and root-cause debugging at the system or silicon level Deep understanding of IC manufacturing, characterization, and qualification processes
